summary: Automations: «My tasks» inbox at /automations/tasks — human-node tasks assigned to the user, their roles, groups or permissions or delegated to them (tasks.TaskInbox over the human tasks substrate), decided with the node's outcome buttons, comment and schema fields, delegated to a colleague, with overdue and decided-by-me tabs and a navigation counter (application.NavNode.Badge). TaskForm extension point (tasks.ContributeTaskForm, `x-iota-form` annotation of the human node's form, validated on save); the module registers the human node, its task bridge and observer, the native event automation.task.assigned.v1 (automations.Natives) and its notification to the assignees with a link to the task; workflow.Engine.TasksByID.
